params.description: Filter by the id of the associated guarantor

params.name: claim_id

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Adjustments updated after the specified time (UTC)

params.name: sort
params.description:
Optional comma-separated string of fields to sort on.
Include a leading dash for descending order.

Available fields:
  * updated_at
  * -updated_at

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: First item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Last item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum allowed amount is 1000.

items.docs: This endpoint returns the ledger adjustments for the specified location. At least one of the patient_id, provider_id, guarantor_id, claim_id, charge_id, or updated_since filters must be provided.
